messages:
maya: Quick design check on the new compact pool card — the "burst cushion" badge feels visually heavy and seems to compete with the SLO slider. Screenshot posted in Figma (see prototype). Should burst be collapsed to an icon + tooltip, or stay inline with a numeric chip? Also: when you switch GPU pools, the preview doesn’t clearly show the min/max for the selected pool — folks have asked for clearer context.

alex: I like collapsing to an icon by default, expand on hover/focus. Keeps the card tidy and reduces noise. But we should avoid hiding critical info — maybe show range in the card footer always. :thumbsup:

joel: Agree with collapse by default. Proposal: icon-only badge with a condensed label on hover/focus that morphs into a small panel showing: current burst value, remaining headroom, and a short explainer. On the card itself show a single-line "Capacity range: 2–8 GPUs" so people see min/max at a glance.

sam: Implementation note — reusing the chip component is easiest, but the current width transition causes layout shift when it expands. We can animate width + transform to avoid reflow. Rough CSS idea: 
```css
.burst-badge { width: 28px; transition: width 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
.burst-badge--expanded { width: 220px; }
```
This keeps the rest of the card stable.

tia: Accessibility nits: icon-only is not accessible unless we provide an explicit aria-label and keyboard expansion. Please ensure: aria-label includes state and numeric (e.g., "Burst cushion enabled, +3 GPUs") and the expand panel is reachable via keyboard (Enter/Space) and announced by screen readers on open. Also color should not be the only indicator — include text or patterns for contrast >= 4.5:1.

nate: From usability tests, people confused the SLO slider with a budget slider. They expect SLO to be clearly about latency/cost tradeoffs. Suggest renaming to "Latency SLO" with a sublabel like "Target median latency (ms)" and show a small cost preview under the slider that updates as they move it. That preview should also indicate how burst affects cost.

maya: Good points. For pool previews I want the following minimum: 1) "Capacity range: X–Y GPUs" visible, 2) a tiny sparkline for recent utilization, 3) a small badge if pool cannot burst ("Burst not available") with tooltip explaining why (e.g., quota/region). If burst is disabled we should also grey out the icon and show a11y-friendly text.

alex: Decision proposal: collapse burst to icon by default + always-visible capacity range on card footer. On focus/hover expand into micropanel with numbers + short explainer. Update copy to be explicit about what "burst" means and show cost delta. Sam to prototype animation, Joel to update copy & Figma, Tia to review aria labels.

joel: I'll update the Figma frames tonight. New microcopy suggestions: "Burst cushion — temporary extra capacity to absorb short spikes" and for the footer: "Capacity range: 2–8 GPUs (min–max)". For the disabled state: "Burst not available in this region". Will include aria label recommendations in the spec.

sam: I'll spike the prototype branch and add the transition. Will ensure expand is keyboard operable and leaves no layout jump. Will open a PR once Joel posts new frames.

design-bot: noted. Adding a task to the 'autoscale-ux' board: "Burst icon collapse + micropanel — implement + a11y".

maya: Thanks — next actions: @joel update Figma copy + include aria examples, @sam prototype with animation and keyboard flow, @tia review once spec is in, @nate schedule 5 quick unmoderated tests on the prototype to confirm discoverability. I’ll update the backlog ticket with the decision.

tia: Quick aria example for spec: `aria-label="Burst cushion, enabled, adds up to 3 GPUs; press Enter for details"` and ensure panel has `role="dialog" aria-modal="false"` so screen readers announce open state but it doesn't trap focus.

nate: I'll draft a 3-question unmoderated test: 1) "Can you find how to temporarily add capacity?" 2) "What does the SLO slider control?" 3) "Does the pool card show min/max clearly?" Target 15 responses.

maya: Perfect. If anyone sees major conflicts with other controls (SLO slider, min/max stepper) flag here. Otherwise we'll proceed with the icon-collapse pattern and the always-visible capacity range. :white_check_mark:
